item.title: New Website Design!
item.description:
Today I felt rather unhappy with my website, so I redid it all again! Completely new! It'll take some time for it to have all the stuff I want it to have but I fuck with it so far.
Don't worry if you missed the old site design, like all the others, it is archived and accessible! I might have to go back and update the images for all my old RSS posts though... ugh..................... ( it is rather weird to type out onamatopeia. it's like when someone's trying to seek out attention so they type "sigh..." in the chat or some bollocks. )

item.title: WallGame is OutGame!
item.description:
This has been in the backburner for a while. WallGame is OUT! I started and basically finished its original Java version in GCSE Computer Science like 2/3 years ago now (wow), but only recently decided to finish it by adding sounds, a soundtrack, some QOL, and ported it in its entirety to Javascript and added Newgrounds shit. Unfortunately the sound system in Java is really jank so I'm not gonna release that just yet and try to fix it, but I hope you like the java version!
(It even has a trailer!)
